name: xinput
note: Issue 34: a controller that walked the launcher and the settings menu and did nothing in the game. The game's controllers are SDL's, kept from XInput (Windows.Gaming.Input and HIDAPI read them); the launcher's and the settings menu's is ImGui's Win32 backend's, XInput. A controller Windows.Gaming.Input does not hand SDL was none to the game. While SDL has no controller at all the game now reads XInput itself (the SDK's core/input.cpp, XInputPad). XBE_XINPUT_FAKE: SDL's controllers left out and XInput a stand-in whose first controller the run's presses set, as vpad's virtual controller is set: its buttons and sticks as the game gets them (with --set button_layout=1 the PS2 layout's swap), both sticks clicked for the settings menu, unplugged and plugged in again, the game's rumble on both motors in a fight. Windows only: XInput is Windows'.

expect: found(runlog, 'controller 1 through XInput: SDL found no controller')
